svg.title: D05 APOLLO CYBER FLIGHT DECK engineering architecture
svg.desc: The isolated workflow evaluates ownership, permitted sharing and safety escalation through synthetic replay. It supports defensive governance comparison without contacting systems or reproducing vulnerabilities.
